note: Set A correctly extracts the text-based metadata regarding the weather data source (Department of Energy, Bowman Field), while Set B invents a specific temperature value for 'Bowman Field' that is not supported by the text or charts. Both sets contain numerous errors in reading the charts, often swapping values between Louisville and Irvine or misreading points, but Set B exhibits a more systematic pattern of attributing Irvine data to Louisville claims (e.g., Louisville Jan Mean 55F is actually Irvine's). Set A is preferred for the faithful text extraction and slightly fewer location-swap errors.
